info.title: Albedian Observation & Media Runtime API
info.description: Deterministic scientific astrometry, astronomy-aware media restoration, and voice action validation.

get.description: Return service health and pinned catalog summary.

schema.title: Response Get Health Api Health Get

post.description:
The bright stars, the solar system bodies, the constellation figures' edges and the sky brightness predicted
for a time and place, every item `predicted`, built to services/contracts/sky_context.py and checked against it
before it is sent: a reply the contract refuses is this route's fault and answers 500.

schema.title: Response Post Science Sky Context Api Science Sky Context Post

post.description:
Return the Krisciunas & Schaefer (1991) sky brightness predicted at the stated target (its altitude and
its separation from the Moon). No sensor limiting magnitude is estimated.

schema.title: Response Post Science Radiometry Audit Api Science Radiometry Audit Post

post.description: Run point-source extraction, triangle-matching plate solving, and held-out WCS verification.

schema.title: Response Post Science Solve Api Science Solve Post

post.description: Fit a camera pose to a detected celestial beacon (the Moon) and the horizon, for the given time and place.

schema.title: Response Post Science Solve Horizon Api Science Solve Horizon Post

post.description: Compute analytical ephemerides for Solar System bodies with explicit `predicted` evidence class.

schema.title: Response Post Science Ephemeris Api Science Ephemeris Post

get.description:
Discover the image and video files in the app's uploads folder: probe their container metadata with
`ffprobe`, hash their content, link rendered variants, and return each item's `ObservationSolution` and
ephemerides. Every path in the answer is relative to its folder.

schema.title: Response Get Media Discover Api Media Discover Get

post.description:
Start, join or return a display copy or restoration job of a stored upload: 202 with a new job, 200 with the
active job it joined or the current succeeded one; poll it at GET /api/ingest/jobs/{job_id}.

get.description: An upload's stored variants and every finished attempt, oldest first; there is no listing across uploads.

schema.title: Response List Variants Api Media  Sha256  Variants Get

get.description: A stored variant's three records: the variant, the graph that made it and the attempt that passed its gate.

schema.title: Response Get Variant Api Media  Sha256  Variants  Variant Id  Get

get.description: The stored variant's bytes, served as the original is: cached privately, never sniffed, shown inline.

A ready variant to take away (REQ-RST-9.1, review row D22): one zip stored without compression, an attachment
named `Albedian restored photo.zip`, holding `Albedian restored photo.png`, the stored file byte for byte, and
`Albedian restored photo.png.json`, its manifest; a clip's is `Albedian restored clip.zip`. The file is read once
to check it hashes to its record before a byte is sent, and again as it is sent.

A ready variant's manifest alone (REQ-RST-9.2), the export's own sidecar, as an attachment named
`Albedian restored photo.png.json` (a clip's `Albedian restored clip.mov.json` or `.mp4.json`).

post.description: Parse natural-language voice intent and validate against session revision & epistemic gates.

Nothing here logs the words, and no model reads them.

post.description:
Start, join or return the solve job of a stored upload, which reports real byte, frame and candidate
denominators. It answers at once: 202 with a new job, 200 with the active job it joined or the current succeeded
one. Follow the job at `GET /api/ingest/jobs/{job_id}`.

An optional JSON body is a person's alignment of the predicted sky (`PersonAlignment`, D24's Solve from here):
that solve is its own job, keyed by the alignment, and its record keeps it. A body that is not one, or one for an
upload with no capture time or place, is refused (422) in the design lane's words (C15).
